title: Take the Last Flight
setup: Black's bishop on b2 has three empty squares around it, a1, c1 and a3, and your rook already watches two.
hint: Your rook owns the back rank and your d-pawn guards c3. Which piece reaches the one square still free?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on e1 covers a1 and c1, and c3 is defended by the d2-pawn, so Bxc3 dxc3 is no rescue. Only a3 was free, and {{Nc4}} takes it while attacking the bishop. Every square is accounted for, and the piece has to go.
